answer: The juniper counter is kept in oasis and canyon publishes each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 5 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
